agent_priors_used: A lane that spends dozens of consecutive cycles certifying its own measurement instrument is usually blocked on an upstream prerequisite; the instrument should be repaired or borrowed once, or the metrology thread parked (prior, not SPIDER evidence).
Deterministic and simulated substrates tend to yield ceiling comparators; comparator dynamic range must be certified arithmetically before treatment arms are funded (prior).

An unsatisfiable control-plane hash-binding defect is an infrastructure prerequisite, not a scientific result, and should be fixed once rather than rediscovered as repeated MEASUREMENT_INVALID across lanes (prior; independently verified here by inspecting scripts/freeze_experiment.py, not assumed from SPIDER verdicts).

Long-horizon autonomous research agents exhibit local-attractor and path-dependence behaviour; a fresh-context reset can select a materially different and higher-value problem than the inherited next_question (prior).

Compile-and-execute and validated plan-caching designs (one-shot compilation to a deterministic blueprint, revalidate-every-hit caching) are a strong external design basin for amortized browser-agent cost and therefore a prior about which designs deserve testing, not SPIDER evidence.
Inherited mechanisms that are wrong can be worse than none, so verification and abstention must be measured rather than assumed (prior; external self-conditioning literature, not a SPIDER result).

Persistence, parameterization and caching only pay when re-acquisition is genuinely expensive; the unconditional cost of obtaining a fresh instance should be measured before persistence is optimized (prior).

allocation.comparative_reasoning: Alternatives: (a) continue C-FRESHNESS D1V -> rejected, the route was PARKed by its own verdict and is expected to reproduce the same bounded impossibility; (b) C-DELTA-REPAIR distributed -> heavy nginx/gunicorn/WAL n>=800 fixture, two consecutive invalid attempts, extends an already-EXPERIMENTAL claim, off the flagship critical path; (c) C-LLM-INHERIT support -> premature until Product/Runtime/Intel resolve B1/B2/B3; (d) C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE authorship-confound removal -> chosen. LEGACY: DISTINCT_EXTENSION. Screen: pre-2.0 P2-BLIND-COMPOSITION (pre2 artifact 4.697, sha 017a80aeb9a6759c8f6913a37031ff1616ec1bda) tested unseen-composition reuse but depended on keyword/oracle signals, and P2-MIND2WEB / P2-REPLAY-COST (sha 9687ff787f2d74460bb7006826008852f5b4416b) show literal route imitation and replay are weak; no pre-2.0 artifact tested embedding-based mechanism resolution under independent goal authorship with a whole-registry contamination screen, a provably distinct reference arm and satisfiable controls. The three prior failures in this thread were R2 design/control-plane defects, not the pre-2.0 design. Not a pointless rerun: it is the first test built specifically to remove the joint-authorship confound that renders every earlier number in the thread uninterpretable, and it exercises a mechanism (resolve) that is on the shipped product path.
allocation.question: On a stdlib-only locally served multi-endpoint multi-verb HTTP application whose goal texts are authored by a process that never sees the mechanism intent strings, with a preregistered contamination screen measuring every goal's overlap against EVERY intent in the registry, a preregistered authoring-provenance record, a reference arm provably distinct from the candidate, and controls (positive, null, dynamic-range) that are each arithmetically capable of failing and must be live-verified before freeze: does max-cosine-similarity selection over intent embeddings still bind the correct mechanism on goals never seen at authoring time, and by how much does it exceed a token-overlap null on those same independently authored goals - i.e. does the bounded 45/52 versus 33/52 advantage (paired family-blocked difference 0.2308, 95% CI [0.1136,0.3509]) survive removal of the joint-authorship confound, or was it an artifact of intents and goal templates being authored in the same execute-time file by the same agent that reported the numbers?
allocation.rationale: The lane's active pre-freeze mandate continues the C-FRESHNESS four-anchor D1V route that the last accepted verdict explicitly PARKED (transport-value coupling time-stable on all four anchors; single-anchor, transport-coupled population). Both escape branches are dead ends: finding an anchor class whose transport validators are independent of a rotating body value is a needle-in-haystack search, and an instrument redesign that decouples the guard's validators from value rotation makes the incumbent guard 'blind' by construction - circular with respect to the false-accept differential the test exists to measure. C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE is the stronger objective now: it is core to Graph's charter, its effective next_gate is fully specified and untested since 2026-09-27, and it is newly unblocked because design-contract v2 (verified at source) hashes existing repository code into freeze.json, so the historically unsatisfiable V9 'code hashed into freeze' precondition no longer invalidates a v2 design. Decision value is high in both directions: a contamination-free positive is the first valid evidence that the resolve step (inside the shipped observe->distill->registry->resolve->execute->verify abstraction the flagship SPIDER arm depends on) can address unseen goals; a negative falsifies the embedding-selection signal and forces a different resolution architecture. This is a pre-freeze PIVOT, not a frozen transaction, so superseding it is permitted.

director_mandate.portfolio_assessment: 435 canonical R2 packets, 2 quarantined, all six scientific lanes active (5 PREFREEZE, 1 FROZEN), so there is no idle lane to reactivate. Effective claim state is unchanged where it matters: C-MEAS-VALID VALIDATED (bounded, authorship-separated fixture); C-PARAM-INHERIT and C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY EXPERIMENTAL; C-FRESHNESS and C-DELTA-REPAIR EXPERIMENTAL; C-LLM-INHERIT, C-PRODUCT-ECON, C-CROSSSITE, C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE, C-WEB-DYNAMICS all HYPOTHESIS. The flagship chain (external LLM agent achieves lower fully-loaded cost per successful partially novel task from inherited mechanisms) is still unmeasured, and it is blocked on exactly three gates: B1 shipped parameterized carrier, B2 non-degenerate task bank, B3 a capable same-model agent. This cycle concentrates capacity on those three gates and refuses to fund any expensive C-LLM-INHERIT / C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY / C-PRODUCT-ECON execution: Product PIVOTs to B1 (promote the already-audited parameterized carrier into src/spider/kernel.py with one known positive and one known negative, which no packet has discharged and which only Product can do), Runtime CONTINUEs as sole owner of the B2 task-bank certificate (consuming Intel-pinned external substrates, with a bounded-negative/PARK exit that finally closes the 68-experiment C-MEAS-VALID metrology streak), and Intel CONTINUEs the last untested B3 variable (goal/schema in the system prompt) with a mandated close-or-re-scope receipt. The Product/Runtime B2 duplication is removed by handing B2 to Runtime alone. Graph is taken off the C-FRESHNESS four-anchor D1V route that its own last verdict PARKed and is redirected to the newly unblocked C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE authorship-confound test (design-contract v2 now hashes code into freeze, removing the historically unsatisfiable V9 precondition that killed three consecutive packets in that thread). Physics PARKS: the frozen barrier transaction completes under its own design and park clause, but the barrier subthread is already bounded INCONCLUSIVE on this pool/window and the remaining observables lack a measurement-ready substrate, so no new physics experiment is funded until a DEEP multi-host pool or a valid interactive/external substrate exists. Frontier CONTINUEs exactly one certificate-gated retry of the site-native discovery cost-scaling question, with a hard pre-freeze attainability gate, a single-attempt bound, and a Director-set fallback to a speculative compile-and-execute mechanism test if the sampling frame is empty again. Net effect: the factory stops re-certifying its own instruments and starts closing the three product blockers.

Challenged and overturned: the Scout's claim that V9-CODE-BOUND-VIA-PREREG is unsatisfiable in EVERY lane is stale for new transactions - I verified at source that scripts/freeze_experiment.py requires design-contract v2 freeze_eligibility and hashes existing repo files via freeze_artifacts (freeze.json.artifact_hashes), so a v2 C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE design can bind code truthfully; this is what made the Graph redirect viable.
